description.content:
Sends a sample payload for the given event type to the specified URL immediately. Useful for verifying that your endpoint is reachable and processing payloads correctly before creating a subscription. The signature in the test request is generated with a random secret (not a saved subscription's secret), so signature verification will fail — this is expected during testing. Returns the HTTP status and body received from your endpoint. **HTTP Request**
`POST https://api.firstpromoter.com/api/v2/company/webhooks/test`

header.description: (Required) Account ID. Found in your FirstPromoter dashboard under Settings → Integrations.

response.name: Test delivery sent — response mirrors what your endpoint returned.
